evidence.explanation: Replacing GameMap and nulling stair/exclusion heads provides the tested logical cleanup performed by three explicit C cleanup calls. This is not a claim about JS garbage collection or all clear-level state.
evidence.proof: Twenty-one populated cases (seven nonempty combinations of region/stair/exclusion registrations × counts1,2,5) and three empty controls compare two resets each. Actual public JS level_init/gas_cloud/ladder/exclusion/reset_level APIs match exact compiled C reset/clear and region/stair/exclusion free functions on zero region count/capacity, no active region array entries and null stair/exclusion heads. Both resets match in all48 stages.
evidence.control: Three empty cases perform two resets without acquiring resources. Populated setups assert every requested list count before reset; second reset verifies idempotent empty state. Gas clouds have damage0,ttl10, no monsters and no turns advanced. C uses valid allocated metadata fixtures and successful allocation, not independent constructor or full pre-reset behavior.
